content:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: HIGH - unusual egress from edge-logdrain (s3-forwarder) detected. 9800 requests to unknown external host in last 3m. alert_id=ebf-7c2

ops-oncall-maria: seeing it. pulling logs and isolating drain. tagging sec.

ajay: @ops-oncall-maria can you confirm customer-facing endpoints impacted? any 5xx surge?

ops-oncall-maria: no 5xx spike on API, just the log-forwarder worker making repeated POSTs to http://54.212.88.101/upload. looks like a misconfigured sink or exfil.

lucy-sec: joining. lucy-sec here. initial ask: rotate any keys that the forwarder has access to, freeze log forwarding from that host, and collect a sample of the POST payloads.

infra-jason: on it - isolating runner group log-forwarder-prod-4 from network (adding security-group deny egress). patching now.

ops-oncall-maria: dumping a sample payload:```json
{"timestamp":"2026-03-17T18:14:02Z","bucket":"staging-app-logs","path":"edge/2026/03/17/xyz.log.gz","body_preview":"<redacted> user_id=acct_1234 action=auth token=ya29..."}
```

lucy-sec: body_preview includes tokens. high chance of PII/credentials. start key rotation for any service account attached to log-forwarder. also start customer-impact assessment, prepare statement.

ajay: who owns the service account? iam shows svc-logdrain-prod principal: svc-logdrain@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com

infra-jason: revoking that service account keys now. creating new short-lived key for validation tasks only.

ops-oncall-maria: creating a quick runbook checklist in the incident ticket: 1) isolate forwarder 2) rotate svc account keys 3) pause downstream delivery 4) search for exfil targets 5) notify legal & customers if necessary.

lucy-sec: agreed. set severity to P2 for now, escalate to P1 if we confirm exfil of production customer logs. I've started collection task: saved 10 POSTs to /tmp/edge-exfil-sample.tar.gz and uploaded to secure case.

ops-oncall-maria: @zendesk-bot create incident ticket: type=security, impact=potential-data-exposure, owner=lucy-sec.

zendesk-bot: Created ticket SEC-2026-1983. Link: https://redwood.support/SEC-2026-1983.

infra-jason: network isolation applied. egress to 54.212.88.101 blocked at edge. forwarder instances FWD-12, FWD-14 cordoned.

ajay: good containment. lucy-sec, can you confirm if the POST targets are public S3 endpoints or attacker-controlled collectors? any CNAMEs?

lucy-sec: reverse DNS shows host is dynamic-hosting[.]xyz, likely attacker-controlled. payloads include compressed log batches with header lines containing user ids and short auth tokens. moving to full impact runbook.

ops-oncall-maria: notification plan: draft to customers with possible exposure timeframe 2026-03-17T17:30-18:12Z, internal legal & privacy tapped. no public statement yet.

lucy-sec: rotate keys for svc-logdrain, rotate any long-lived tokens found in the sample (list attached to SEC ticket). start re-ingestion checks for loss.

infra-jason: new keys issued, old keys disabled. deploying config to point forwarder to internal quarantine bucket for replay checks.

ops-oncall-maria: who will own customer notifications? cc: @ajay and @lucy-sec for review.

ajay: product comms can draft, security will review. set expected cadence: 2h for initial notification to affected customers.

lucy-sec: taking lead on impact assessment and legal briefing. will update SEC-2026-1983 every 30m. current status: contained, suspected exfil confirmed, rotation in progress.

ops-oncall-maria: thanks team. switching to oncall-handoff mode: i'll sign out in 45m and hand to night shift. leaving followups: validate replay, run grep across last 72h for tokens, redact and revert any retained leaked copies.

pagerbot: incident status update: contained -> actions ongoing. next update in 30m.
